lines.line: Worktree /home/user/pfc-worktree checked out to pf25-wvwi-20260910 at cf2e93239157eb6d42c0e50b7ded17f1798770ba, confirmed with git rev-parse HEAD. Sparse checkout narrowed with `git sparse-checkout set` (never `add`) to swap the de/in/ky/mn overlay cones for wv and wi and to materialize src/lib/legal-authority and src/lib/rcap-engine; df -h /home/user held at 4.0G free before and after.

Both families claimed before any family content was read: CLAIM_OK PF25 wv_nc_acquittal_dismissal-set (packet-build, grant set cb8e7d7a03867ab2) and CLAIM_OK PF25 wi_exp_cr266-set (packet-build, grant set cb8e7d7a03867ab2), each exit 0.

All three declared source digests re-measured with sha256sum against MASTER_LIBRARY_SOURCE_DIR and matched byte-exact: SCA-C903 bbfcd767b02230300e2164a40cc2d81967c87fb9b7ddf4f0677622e1319fe878, CR-266 9f94674c0f931b66654d39ecfd074d897880f71523592bf83f2bd0dd34812412, CR-267 2c0ac53b03658dc9ae93ba90f527ba162d487f181fd4525d5856b483f17930bb. No substitution was made for any of them.

SCA-C903 read from the pinned bytes: 3 pages, 612x792 pts, no /AcroForm, no /Annots on any page, AES-256 R6/V5 with an empty user password. No selection control of any kind exists on the form, so a "ground" on it is a printed recital. The document prints exactly one disposition recital — paragraph 2, "this matter was dismissed by the ____ Court of ____ County", with blanks captioned (Date of Dismissal), (Type of Court: Municipal, Magistrate, Circuit) and (Reason for Dismissal.).

MAPPING RESULT. Dismissal maps to paragraph 2 exactly, one candidate ground, elected. ACQUITTAL maps to ZERO grounds: "acquittal" occurs 5 times in the document and every occurrence is the document naming itself (page-1 title block, three running footers, the certificate of service naming the paper served); "not guilty" and "verdict" occur nowhere. Refused rather than written to the nearest ground.

Tested whether the refusal is an artefact of which binary is bound. The other SCA-C903 in custody (242048f1ff5b2e795ca43900bec6d9c353c59950bffd3c7776374ff1cc6c7035, 2 pages, AcroForm, unencrypted) carries the SAME dismissal-only operative body. Read for that test only; nothing was substituted.

STOPPED, stopClass DISPOSITION_FACT_MAPS_TO_NO_GROUND_ON_THE_BOUND_FORM. Overlay directory data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1/wv/wv-nc-acquittal-dismissal-set--official-pdf-fill NOT created. All nine counters null, not zero. No render performed, so no pixel difference and no output-byte glyph reading exists to report for this family.

CR-266 and CR-267 both read from the pinned bytes: 1 page each, 612x792, no /AcroForm, zero annotations, zero stroked check-box paths. CR-266 has NO selection control of any kind — its only symbol glyphs are three SymbolMT marks that the font's own /ToUnicode CMap maps to U+F0B7, the Symbol bullet, heading the three-item list under paragraph 1.

MAPPING RESULT. The owner's action asks for established discharge facts to be mapped to exact CR-266 SELECTIONS; CR-266 has none, so the mapping resolves to a precondition over the record: the four established discharge facts select WHICH FORM is used. Gate: expungement ordered at sentencing=true (CR-266 para 2), probation=false (para 3), jail or prison=false (para 4), sentence completed=true (para 5). Authority quoted verbatim from the compiled WI profile: "CR-266 is only for adult conviction cases where expungement was already ordered and there was no probation/incarceration."

HARD STOP EXECUTED AND PROVED. The gate runs before any source is bound, and on every build it is also run against a copy of the canonical record with matter.wi_sentence_included_probation set to null. It refused. The build stops if that record is ever accepted.

PARTICIPANT ASSERTIONS. CR-266 paragraphs 1 to 6 are participant assertions and are PRE-PRINTED, so there was no blank to leave blank. Nothing was written in the declaration block, the signature and its date were left empty, and all six are printed verbatim in the guide — with paragraph 1's three bulleted sub-items kept apart by the indent the form prints (bullet x=92.06, continuation x=110.06), because the SymbolMT bullets are dropped by the text extractor and reading the paragraph as one string runs three printed list items into one sentence the form does not print.

Two shared rules found on CR-266, each carrying two blanks with no printed divider: y=228.29 under "Email Address" (x=284.69) and "Telephone Number" (x=457.75), and y=206.69 under "Date" and "State Bar No. (if any)". Each blank's extent is bounded by the printed x of the caption beside it — measured, not chosen — and recorded as ruleSpanTaken/sharesRuleWith.

DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED IN THIS LANE'S OWN BUILDER: the assembled packet was not reproducible. Two runs produced byte-identical per-document PDFs and DIFFERENT packet digests, because PDFDocument.create() stamps the wall clock. stampDeterministic applied; two consecutive full builds now produce byte-identical artifacts across all six digests.

SOURCE RENDER PROVED. Each pinned source rendered twice at 600 dpi, with annotations and from a pdf-lib control copy with /Annots deleted and /AcroForm dropped: CR-266 difference 0 (1,073,979 dark either way), CR-267 difference 0 (1,014,311 either way) — both declare zero annotations, so there is no widget /AP /N ink to lose. The same command over an AcroForm control (SCA-C-903, 242048f1..., 25 fields) draws 35,765 dark pixels on page 1 and 8,846 on page 2 from annotations ALONE, so the renderer draws /AP /N ink and a zero from it means something.

DIRECTIONAL DIFFERENCE, per page, 600 dpi, grey<128. canonical p1 CR-266 +95,038 / -0; p2 CR-267 +35,438 / -0. boundary p1 +106,172 / -0; p2 +48,402 / -0. Negative-control REGIONS this build writes nothing in: CR-266 declarations (523,845 source dark) 0/0, CR-266 footer (86,830) 0/0, CR-267 everything below the caption (643,564) 0/0, CR-267 footer (86,551) 0/0. All 600 dpi intermediates deleted as read.

Delivered bytes read, not just the build report: both fixtures text-extracted and searched for route keys, component ids, digests and census vocabulary — none on either filed page; pages read at 200 and 300 dpi with all six declarations unmarked, both signature lines empty, both dates empty and all eight CR-267 check boxes unmarked.

COMPLETED. Nine counters all zero as the BUILDER's own count using the repository's contract functions; no verifier was run over these packets by this lane and no verdict was set. rasterState BUILT_RASTER_PENDING, --no-raster passed deliberately, no workflow dispatched.

npm run rcap:verify-governance-preservation exited 0: EVERY_GOVERNANCE_KEY_SURVIVED_WHERE_MEASURABLE (285 not measured) and GOVERNANCE_PRESERVATION_OK, 16 checks. The 285 not measured are product-wiring.json files absent from this sparse checkout, which the verifier warns about itself. That is a limit of the worktree, not a pass over them. Neither family had an acceptance receipt, so carryForwardGovernance had nothing to preserve and was not invoked.
